# ScreenshotOne

ScreenshotOne is a screenshot API for developers, enabling the rendering of website screenshots through simple API calls without managing browser clusters.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/screenshotone/.

## Actions

- **Take Animated Screenshot** (read-only): This tool captures an animated screenshot (video or gif) of a given website url.
